title: dsh-panellist configuration
description: Shape of $DSH_HOME/panellist.json. One document holds one profile section per DSH profile id, because different profiles mount different plugins.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped when the shape changes: this const is what `src/shared/config.ts` and the migration table in `src/shared/migrate.ts` are held to. Version 2 removed the retired `locked` panel list; older documents are migrated on read, and a document that cannot be read is backed up before defaults are used.

profiles.description: Keyed by DSH profile id. A profile section is created on first write.

panelId.description: A panel entry id as registered into the rail, discovered at runtime. Never hardcoded.

groupId.description: A group id owned by this plugin. Must not collide with any plugin's panel id.

sequence.description: Partially authoritative: listed items appear in this order; panel entries that are not listed are appended at the end in the shell's own order.

entries.description: Per-panel display overrides, keyed by panel id. An id that is no longer registered is preserved and reported as an orphan.

label.description: Group trigger name. Defaults to the first member's effective name.

icon.description: Group trigger icon. Defaults to the first member's effective icon.

hidden.description: Hides the group trigger itself from the rail.

members.description: Ordered panel ids inside this group. One level of nesting only: a member may not be another group.

label.description: Display-name override. Affects the rail row text, the collapsed tooltip and the accessible name only.

hidden.description: Hides the row. A hidden panel that is currently active still shows its row.

name.description: Name in the icon set bundled with the plugin (no network, no extra dependency).

svg.description: Inline SVG source. Sanitized against an allow-list (no script, foreignObject, event attributes or external references) on write and on read, capped at 64 KB, and rendered inline so it can follow the theme.
